title: series.json: the catalog
description: Every series aseri forecasts, with its unit, horizon, newest data and forecast, source, licence and links; the model; the quantile levels; aseri's own licence; and the errata.

generated_at.description: When the daily run wrote the site.

revision.description: The pinned commit of the weights.

quantile_levels.description: The 21 levels every forecast gives. A new set would be a new major version.

license.description: aseri's forecasts, scores and API: CC BY-NC 4.0. Upstream terms still apply to the underlying data.

errata.description: Corrections, oldest first. A forecast is never edited: an erratum says what was wrong, and the original stays published and scored.

series_id.description: The series concerned, or null for all of them.

reference_date.description: The forecast concerned, or null for a series' other files.

links.description: Additive to v1: the API's other files, relative to series.json. Left out on a day the bulk files could not be written.

bulk.description: The data package of the bulk files: every forecast, observation and score in Parquet and CSV.

baseline.description: What the page's "vs" figures compare with: a fixed value, or the mean of the last 365 days.

horizon_max.description: The steps of every forecast, 1 to this.

interval_steps.description: The steps the page lists ranges for.

latest_forecast_date.description: The run day that issued latest.json.

stale_since.description: The day its data turned late, or null while it is on time.

note.description: Why the latest forecast starts before the last observation, then any standing caveat on the data.

weekly.description: Whether its values follow the week, so a day compares with the same weekday.

day_to_day_tie.description: How the real days moved together within a forecast: the lag-1 correlation of the normal scores of their PITs over the last 120 days, 0 below 100 pairs.

license.description: The source's terms. aseri's forecasts of it are also under the catalog's license.

links.description: The series' files, relative to series.json. scores is left out when its scores failed that day.
